wallpaper-base.purpose: Page base under the fixed silver gradient; browser theme colour.

ink-quiet.purpose: Captions, table heads, footer labels, dimmed steps (5.7:1 light, 7.0:1 dark).

ink-faint.purpose: Placeholders, message times, typing dots, neutral status dots.

action-blue.purpose: One filled button per decision; open FAQ tile; footer go tile; focus ring; caret.

action-blue-hover.purpose: Hover of the action blue; keeps white at 4.5:1.

on-action.purpose: Text on action blue, violet and night.

glass-surface.purpose: Lower stop of the glass stage gradient.

glass-surface-hi.purpose: Upper stop of the glass stage gradient.

tile.purpose: Tiles, rows, table stripes, footer board; one tone off the wallpaper.

fill.purpose: Grey pill buttons, segmented nav track, rows inside UI cards.

hairline.purpose: Only inside fragments: chat header and caption dividers.

sheet.purpose: Solid surface: phone menu, chat header, UI cards, closing dialog.

night.purpose: The closing field and the footer wordmark tile.

toran-green.purpose: Toran's mark tile; 'answered alone' dots and pills.

teder-violet.purpose: Teder's mark tile; the one colour field.

warn.purpose: Form errors, invalid border, draft banner, placeholder outline.

warn-ground.purpose: Form message and draft banner ground.

display.purpose: Every h1 and h2, the typed question line and the footer wordmark.

lead.purpose: h3, FAQ questions, ledes and about paragraphs (400 at 1.45), the close line.

small.purpose: Captions, labels, table heads, legal, credits.

wallpaper.purpose: Fixed behind the page (body::before); hue-less silver.

glass.purpose: Header capsule and product stages only; solid under Reduce Transparency or without backdrop-filter support.

shadows.name: glass-stage
shadows.purpose: Glass stages holding product fragments. Dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 14px 36px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.7).

shadows.name: header-rest
shadows.purpose: Header capsule at the top of the page.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Header once scrolled; the open phone menu. Dark: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.4).

shadows.name: message
shadows.purpose: WhatsApp's own bubble shadow, inside chats only.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: The demo dialog on the night field.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.value: outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #0071e3 60%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every arrival, press and state change.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Buttons and suggestion chips; footer go tile scales to 0.985.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: opacity 700ms, translateY(22px) to 0 over 900ms ease-out, 80ms stagger
motion.purpose: Children of a data-rise group, once on arrival.

motion.name: chat-play
motion.value: opacity + translateY(8px) scale(0.98), 350ms/450ms ease-out; first at 400ms, typing dots 1000ms before each reply, 600ms after, 800ms between sent messages
motion.purpose: A data-play stage plays its chat once in view.

motion.name: held-state
motion.purpose: 'How it goes' fragment changes state with the statement at mid-screen (desk, with script).

motion.name: photo-reveal
motion.purpose: Archival photo frames open from the top once.

motion.name: photo-drift
motion.purpose: Large photographs settle as they arrive.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Content is visible by default; nothing waits or moves.

accessibilityModes: prefers-contrast: more (quiet ink to ink, glass and tiles near solid)

narrative.overview:
The site lives inside the Teder owner-site world, pinned by the owner's brief: a silver wallpaper with no hue of its own, frosted glass with a lit edge, the system typeface with Heebo behind it, pill buttons, and one action blue. Inside that world the page is quiet so the product can be loud. The colour, the detail and the motion belong to working fragments of Toran (marked `data-ui`): a WhatsApp chat with its own bubbles, greens and times; a settings card that changes state; a duty log with the present minute on it. Everything around those fragments is silver surfaces of the same tone, five type sizes and generous space.

Depth is rationed. Glass is reserved for what floats (the header capsule) and for the stages a product fragment stands on. Every other surface is a tile one tone step off the wallpaper, with no line and no shadow. The one dark surface in the light theme is the closing field; the one colour field is Teder's violet. Three credited black-and-white archival photographs stand for the world around the product, never for its customers.

The page is Hebrew, right to left, phone first, and in light and dark from the same tokens. It honours Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency by making the glass and tiles nearly solid, and Reduce Motion by showing everything in place.
keyCharacteristics: Hue-less silver wallpaper (a fixed radial plus linear gradient over the wallpaper base)
Glass only on the header and the product's stages, with a lit 1px rim
Tiles one tone step off the wallpaper, without lines or shadows
Five visible type sizes, system stack with Heebo
One filled action blue per decision, and every other button a grey pill
Product fragments carry their own interface conventions and sizes

rules.name: The No Hue Wallpaper Rule
rules.body: The wallpaper and every tile are hue-less silver. Colour arrives only with the product's fragments, the brand marks, the action blue and the one violet field.

rules.name: The One Blue Per Decision Rule
rules.body: Each decision gets one filled action-blue button. Every other button is a grey pill. The open FAQ tile and the footer's go tile are the only other blue fills.

rules.name: The Mark Colour Rule
rules.body: A mark's tile colour is the product's own and never the accent. The marks are the brand files and are never redrawn.

rules.name: The Five Sizes Rule
rules.body: Outside product fragments, visible text uses only figure, display, lead, body and small.

rules.name: The No Colon Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings are whole Hebrew sentences or phrases, never "label: statement", and never split by a colon.

rules.name: The Glass Means Something Rule
rules.body: Glass goes on the header and on the stages product fragments stand on. Nothing else is glass, and glass is never nested in glass (the open menu is solid sheet).

rules.name: The No Line, No Shadow Tile Rule
rules.body: Tiles, rows, table stripes and the footer board are separated by one tone step alone.

dos: **Do** keep the wallpaper and tiles hue-less, and let colour enter through product fragments, brand marks, the action blue and the single violet field.
**Do** give each decision exactly one filled action-blue pill, and make every other button a grey pill.
**Do** put glass only on the header and the stages that hold product fragments, with the lit edge (inset 1px edge plus 1px top rim).
**Do** separate tiles, rows and table stripes by one tone step, at 18px for surfaces and 12px for inner elements.
**Do** keep visible text to the five sizes, and let fragments keep their interface sizes inside `data-ui`.
**Do** label every made-up chat, day and store as an example, and take every fact from site.config.json.
**Do** make motion play once, on the out curve, with content visible by default and nothing moving under reduced motion.
**Do** provide solid fallbacks for Increase Contrast, Reduce Transparency and browsers without backdrop blur.
donts: **Don't** add lines or shadows to tiles, or nest glass inside glass.
**Don't** use a brand mark's colour as the accent, or redraw a mark.
**Don't** present the archival photographs as customers, stores or the team, or show them in colour.
**Don't** build the category's hero plus three identical feature cards plus logos plus pricing cards. Show the product working instead.
**Don't** let WhatsApp's greens and chat ground leave a chat fragment.
**Don't** invent customers, testimonials, logos or numbers, and don't offer a free trial.
